entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (hip), who is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game at Denver, has been hampered by a groin injury that has impacted his explosiveness, and while the Rams haven't taken surgery "entirely off the table," the issue is considered "short term," with a return possible sooner rather than later, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (knee), who is listed as questionable for Week 3, is expected to make his season debut Sunday at New Orleans, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans (hip) remains listed as questionable for Sunday's game versus the Cardinals but intends to play, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Tyson Bagent
entries.summary: Bagent (concussion) was a full participant in Saturday's practice but is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Eagles.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: Flowers (hamstring) "looked good" during a pregame workout, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, and the Ravens are still mulling whether he'll play, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce

entries.name: David Njoku

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
